name: admin_workspace
description: Fetches a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk workspace by ID.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version counter, incremented on each update.

attributes.name: persona_ids
attributes.description: IDs of the personas assigned to this workspace.

attributes.name: knowledge_ids
attributes.description: IDs of the knowledge bases assigned to this workspace.

attributes.name: scope_ids
attributes.description: IDs of the scopes assigned to this workspace.

attributes.name: agent_ids
attributes.description: IDs of the agents assigned to this workspace.

attributes.name: project_ids
attributes.description: IDs of the projects assigned to this workspace.

attributes.name: ticket_ids
attributes.description: IDs of the tickets assigned to this workspace.

attributes.name: incident_ids
attributes.description: IDs of the incidents assigned to this workspace.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the workspace was created (RFC 3339).

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the workspace was last updated (RFC 3339).
